en.title: Simulate a slow network and packet loss in Playwright tests
en.description: A Playwright Test fixture that adds real latency, packet loss or an outage to one server, in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit alike, on Windows and Linux.

pl.title: Wolna sieć i utrata pakietów w testach Playwright
pl.description: Fixture do Playwright Test, który dodaje jednemu serwerowi prawdziwe opóźnienie, utratę pakietów albo awarię, tak samo w Chromium, Firefoksie i WebKicie.

zh-Hans.title: 在 Playwright 测试中模拟慢网络和丢包
zh-Hans.description: 一个 Playwright Test fixture，为单个服务器加入真实的延迟、丢包或断网，在 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 中效果相同，支持 Windows 和 Linux。

ja.link_text: Playwright で遅いネットワーク
ja.title: Playwright のテストで遅いネットワークとパケットロスを再現
ja.description: 1つのサーバーに本物の遅延、パケットロス、切断を加える Playwright Test のフィクスチャ。Chromium、Firefox、WebKit で同じように効きます。

de.title: Langsames Netz und Paketverlust in Playwright-Tests simulieren
de.description: Eine Playwright-Test-Fixture, die einem Server echte Latenz, Paketverlust oder einen Ausfall gibt, in Chromium, Firefox und WebKit gleich.

fr.title: Simuler un réseau lent et des pertes de paquets dans Playwright
fr.description: Une fixture Playwright Test qui ajoute une vraie latence, des pertes de paquets ou une coupure à un serveur, dans Chromium, Firefox et WebKit.

es.title: Simula una red lenta y pérdida de paquetes en pruebas Playwright
es.description: Un fixture de Playwright Test que añade latencia real, pérdida de paquetes o un corte a un servidor, igual en Chromium, Firefox y WebKit, en Windows y Linux.

pt-BR.title: Simule rede lenta e perda de pacotes em testes Playwright
pt-BR.description: Uma fixture do Playwright Test que adiciona latência real, perda de pacotes ou uma queda a um servidor, igual no Chromium, Firefox e WebKit, no Windows e Linux.

it.title: Simulare rete lenta e perdita di pacchetti nei test Playwright
it.description: Una fixture di Playwright Test che aggiunge latenza reale, perdita di pacchetti o un'interruzione a un server, in Chromium, Firefox e WebKit.

id.title: Simulasikan jaringan lambat dan packet loss di tes Playwright
id.description: Fixture Playwright Test yang menambah latensi nyata, packet loss, atau pemutusan ke satu server, sama di Chromium, Firefox, dan WebKit, di Windows dan Linux.

ru.title: Медленная сеть и потеря пакетов в тестах Playwright
ru.description: Фикстура Playwright Test, которая добавляет одному серверу настоящую задержку, потерю пакетов или обрыв: одинаково в Chromium, Firefox и WebKit.

tr.title: Playwright testlerinde yavaş ağ ve paket kaybı simülasyonu
tr.description: Tek bir sunucuya gerçek gecikme, paket kaybı veya kesinti ekleyen bir Playwright Test fixture'ı: Chromium, Firefox ve WebKit'te aynı.

cs.title: Simulace pomalé sítě a ztráty paketů v testech Playwright
cs.description: Fixture pro Playwright Test, která jednomu serveru přidá skutečnou latenci, ztrátu paketů nebo výpadek, stejně v Chromiu, Firefoxu i WebKitu.

vi.title: Mô phỏng mạng chậm và mất gói trong kiểm thử Playwright
vi.description: Một fixture Playwright Test thêm độ trễ thật, mất gói hoặc mất kết nối cho một máy chủ, như nhau trên Chromium, Firefox và WebKit, trên Windows và Linux.

hi.title: Playwright टेस्ट में धीमा नेटवर्क और पैकेट लॉस
hi.description: एक Playwright Test fixture जो एक सर्वर पर असली लेटेंसी, पैकेट लॉस या आउटेज जोड़ता है, Chromium, Firefox और WebKit में एक जैसा, Windows और Linux पर।

ko.title: Playwright 테스트에서 느린 네트워크와 패킷 손실 시뮬레이션
ko.description: 한 서버에 실제 지연, 패킷 손실, 끊김을 더하는 Playwright Test fixture. Chromium, Firefox, WebKit에서 똑같이 작동합니다.

ar.title: محاكاة شبكة بطيئة وفقدان الحزم في اختبارات Playwright
ar.description: أداة fixture لـ Playwright Test تضيف تأخيرًا حقيقيًا أو فقدان حزم أو انقطاعًا لخادم واحد، بالطريقة نفسها في Chromium وFirefox وWebKit، على Windows وLinux.

ro.title: Simulează o rețea lentă și pierderi de pachete în Playwright
ro.description: Un fixture Playwright Test care adaugă latență reală, pierderi de pachete sau o întrerupere unui server, la fel în Chromium, Firefox și WebKit.

nl.title: Een traag netwerk en pakketverlies simuleren in Playwright-tests
nl.description: Een Playwright Test-fixture die één server echte latentie, pakketverlies of een storing geeft, gelijk in Chromium, Firefox en WebKit, op Windows en Linux.

zh-Hant.title: 在 Playwright 測試中模擬慢網路和封包遺失
zh-Hant.description: 一個 Playwright Test fixture，為單一伺服器加入真實的延遲、封包遺失或斷線，在 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 中效果相同，支援 Windows 和 Linux。

uk.title: Повільна мережа і втрата пакетів у тестах Playwright
uk.description: Фікстура Playwright Test, що додає одному серверу справжню затримку, втрату пакетів або обрив: однаково в Chromium, Firefox і WebKit, на Windows і Linux.

th.link_text: เครือข่ายช้าใน Playwright
th.title: จำลองเครือข่ายช้าและแพ็กเก็ตสูญหายในการทดสอบ Playwright
th.description: fixture ของ Playwright Test ที่เพิ่มความหน่วงจริง แพ็กเก็ตสูญหาย หรือการตัดการเชื่อมต่อให้เซิร์ฟเวอร์เดียว ได้ผลเหมือนกันใน Chromium, Firefox และ WebKit
